apps.message:
feat(entries): list Typonaut, a touch-typing game

## Intent

List Typonaut in the catalog, as the last step of the first full creator run of the interactive archetype: a session that knows only the public guidance and skills builds an app from the build prompt to the listing.

## Key changes

- A catalog entry for Typonaut: Informatik for grades 3 to 13, at https://mrsimpson.github.io/typonaut/, in German and English.
- Words fly across the screen and turn into stardust when typed; chapter by chapter new keys join, from the home row to the whole keyboard.
- Two topics: German with a German keyboard (QWERTZ) and English with an English keyboard (QWERTY).
- Limits stated openly: not usable with a screen reader and not meant for phones.
- Fitness: no account, no install, storage on the device, no third parties.
- The creator is Oliver, linked to his GitHub profile.

moved.why: Corrects the creator name of the same entry; i024 has no commits left.
